title: Reply drafts survive synchronized thread redraws
scope: The pull-request reply-draft store, the inline Markdown Preview thread that subscribes to it, reset invalidation, and focused verification needed to review draft and focus preservation; other comment composer state and non-Markdown thread surfaces are excluded. The independent watch-acknowledgement area is handled by a separate map; PR-wide documentation and the compact CI-history change are left to direct code rather than joined by a same-PR relation.

presentation.thesis: Reply body and focus are externalized per pull request, thread, and surface so a synchronized Markdown Preview redraw can restore the active reply while an explicit review reset invalidates it.

nodes.label: comment-draft-store.ts
nodes.description: Stores revision-guarded reply body and focus snapshots by pull request and thread surface, and notifies remounted subscribers.

nodes.label: CommentThread.tsx
nodes.description: Subscribes to a thread reply snapshot, restores focused input after remount, and persists textarea changes and deletion cleanup.

nodes.label: DocumentViewer.tsx
nodes.description: Renders inline CommentThread instances for Markdown Preview annotations that may redraw after synchronized updates.

nodes.label: App.tsx
nodes.description: Polls the change sequence, passes synchronized comments into the document viewer, and clears drafts before review reset.

nodes.label: comment-draft-store.test.ts
nodes.description: Verifies an in-progress reply is retained until review reset and a stale revision cannot restore it.

nodes.label: review-flow.spec.ts
nodes.description: Verifies a Markdown Preview reply retains its body and focus when another comment synchronizes into the view.
